atomic_claims.text: The /bueroreinigung 7-day mean organic clicks fell from 41.0/day (window ending 2026-08-17) to 22.0/day (window starting 2026-08-18).
Over 28 days the /bueroreinigung page received 3000 impressions and 30 clicks across three pricing/quote-intent queries it does not answer on-page.
Sibling PSS service pages that carry a pricing/quote H2 achieved a 4.00% impression-weighted CTR for equivalent-intent queries versus 1.00% for the /bueroreinigung gap queries.
Four pages sharing the identical 2026-08-17 shared-header change, and not in the content-gap situation, moved at most 4% in 7-day mean clicks over 2026-08-18 to 2026-08-24.

public_evidence.method: mean of the seven daily values in each window: before = 2026-08-11..2026-08-17, after = 2026-08-18..2026-08-24
public_evidence.limitations: Establishes the size and timing of the click change only; it does not identify a cause. This claim is background context for the test, not the opportunity under verification.

public_evidence.method: sum impressions and clicks over the three gap queries; impression-weighted CTR = sum clicks / sum impressions; read the current on-page H2 list
public_evidence.limitations: Fictional counts. Establishes the on-page content gap and that the query panel is large enough to power an 8-week CTR test; it does not by itself prove the gap is worth closing.

public_evidence.method: impression-weighted CTR (sum pricing-intent clicks / sum pricing-intent impressions) over three sibling pages that carry a pricing/quote H2, restricted to the same three query intents so per-page impression volume does not distort the benchmark
public_evidence.limitations: Fictional benchmark. A CTR difference is consistent with, but does not prove, that the pricing/quote H2 is the cause of the sibling pages' higher CTR.

public_evidence.method: percent change in 7-day mean clicks for each control page over the same windows as EV-0001
public_evidence.deploy_diff_scope: 2026-08-17 shared header partial only; no /bueroreinigung page body change
public_evidence.limitations: Six control pages only. Separates the shared-header deploy from the -46% fall on /bueroreinigung; it does not name the fall's cause and does not fully exclude a page-specific header effect.

pss_data.decline_cause_status: not established; the 2026-08-18 click and position decline is background context only and is not what this test measures
pss_data.implementation_constraint: one operator; static site with a blog generator; on-page text edits are reversible by reverting one commit

test_plan.hypothesis: Adding three original H2 sections to /bueroreinigung that answer 'bueroreinigung kosten musterstadt', 'bueroreinigung angebot musterstadt' and 'unterhaltsreinigung buero musterstadt' raises the CTR for those three exact queries toward the 4.00% sibling-page benchmark, without worsening the top-query position.
test_plan.baseline: 28-day impression-weighted CTR for the three gap queries on /bueroreinigung = 1.00% (30 clicks / 3000 impressions); top-query average position = 8.9.
test_plan.change: Add three original H2 sections answering the three named queries; no competitor text; no other page touched.
test_plan.kpi: 28-day CTR for the three named queries on /bueroreinigung
test_plan.period: 8 weeks after the change versus the prior 8 weeks
test_plan.success_threshold: combined CTR for the three named queries reaches at least 2.5% with top-query average position no worse than 9.5
test_plan.stop_threshold: top-query average position worse than 12 for two consecutive weeks, or total page clicks fall a further 15%
test_plan.rollback: revert the single H2 commit; the page returns to its prior state
test_plan.observation_window: 8 weeks, with an interim read at week 4
